conclusion: No accepted artifact currently supplies a prefix-complete closed finite graph for all H72 candidates.

models.name: Phase 7 macro alphabet
models.reason: The artifact is a finite factor alphabet without a closed transition graph. Free one-state concatenation would be a Type III overapproximation only.

models.name: Phase 8 A/B coefficient semigroup
models.reason: A expands and B contracts in the coefficient coordinate, but literal integer admissibility uses unbounded affine state and guards.

models.name: Phase 10/11 two-tail states
models.reason: Residues, ordinary heights, and affine margins grow with the horizon.

models.name: Phase 13 square-root countermodel
models.reason: The defect controller tracks an unbounded square-root-scale state; NG22 supplies a coherent 2-adic source but no positive ordinary integer.

models.name: Phase 14 coalescent quotient
models.reason: NG24 refutes left-congruence/prefix closure of the finite endpoint quotient.

models.name: Phase 16 local predecessor rules
models.reason: The rules are local height-conditioned exclusions, not a complete transition presentation.

models.name: Phase 17 suffix code
models.reason: All 11 selected codewords expand and suffix decoding is exact, but the code is only a sublanguage of the critical branch.
